metadata.description: Public skills for security research, security conference intelligence, speaker coaching, writing quality, and RSS feed triage

plugins.name: writing
plugins.description: Writing quality tools: eliminate AI slop from prose and write narrative memos in Amazon style (6-pagers, 1-pagers, press releases, PRFAQs).

plugins.name: seccon
plugins.description: Security conference intelligence for security researchers — academic (aggregate rank from CORE 2023 + Guofei Gu: IEEE S&P, CCS, USENIX Security, NDSS, IACR tiers) and industry (DEF CON, Black Hat, REcon, Troopers, hardwear.io). Live calendar via confsearch.ethz.ch and cfptime.org. Paper/talk evaluation, author search, cross-conference topic scans.

plugins.name: speaker-coach
plugins.description: Coaches cybersecurity speakers through a disciplined backwards-design interview, audits existing talk drafts adversarially, and walks rehearsal critique and T-2-week readiness gates. Adapts to academic, industry, and grassroots venue norms.

plugins.name: news
plugins.description: Read, search, and triage RSS feeds through the Miniflux MCP server.
